scope: Evidence for individual checks; not a declaration of universal Linux support.
limitations: Isolated Xvfb/Weston checks do not certify a real desktop session.
Package lifecycle success does not prove version upgrade or microphone capture.
Local evidence paths refer to retained task artifacts and are not distributed in Git.
Unverified architecture/target combinations remain required work.
